study_design: Comparison of blood trace-element concentrations between patients with already diagnosed prostate cancer and healthy volunteers.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study covered 66 patients with diagnosed prostate cancer and 64 healthy volunteers over 50 years old.
reason: The study compared prevalent prostate cancer patients with healthy volunteers and did not establish incident prostate cancer follow-up or an aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Additionally, the study group had lower concentrations of chromium, zinc, but also cadmium and lead, which are commonly regarded as carcinogenic.
estimate_classifications.reason: The zinc comparison concerns general, already diagnosed prostate cancer status. It is neither an aggressive endpoint nor a prospective incidence estimate.
